svg.text: Baseline from parent coordinate tables. Dashed red = proposal, NOT approved.
Scale: 5 pixels per stud. North = -Z, east = +X. Drawing only, not a Studio capture.
Both use Z=-192..-112; not two assets.
Amber: illustrative outdoor path (no passage through closed room wall).
Red dots: baseline anchors. Green dots: six suggested signpost locations, not frozen.
Z6 shift X=4..16 exceeds current X=12 extent; decision required. Shops shown only as later-phase massing.
No approval, FPS, streaming or runtime behaviour inferred from this drawing.
